{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D1F2F), soft merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey (#3A3D42), textured wool flannel
Thermal tights worn under the trousers, opaque, ankle length, black (#1A1A1A), fine merino-blend knit
Knee-length wool-blend coat, tailored with a notch collar, single-breasted, camel (#B88A5A), dense brushed wool with a water-repellent finish
Ankle boots, rounded toe, low block heel, grippy rubber lug sole, waterproof, dark brown (#3B2A20), treated leather with a warm lining
Wool socks, mid-calf, heather grey (#8A8D91), thick merino blend
Long scarf, wrapped twice at the neck, oatmeal (#D8CBB4), soft lambswool
Knitted beanie, snug fit, charcoal (#4A4D52), ribbed wool with a fleece lining
Lined gloves, wrist length, black (#1A1A1A), leather with a cashmere lining
Structured tote, medium size, closed top, dark brown (#3B2A20), smooth grained leather

This outfit keeps the neat office look with a refined knit and tailored wool trousers, while the coat, scarf, hat and gloves handle the deep frost on your 20-minute walk. The waterproof lug-sole boots are the practical choice for snow and salted pavements, and the dark trousers hide salt splashes at the hem. The burgundy knit adds warmth of colour against the grey and camel, so the layers look composed rather than bulky. A closed tote keeps your things dry in the snow."}
